errors.text_span: The bars are color-coded to distinguish each criterion
errors.evidence: The description does not specify the exact colors associated with each criterion, only that they are color-coded. The atom specifies unique colors for each bar.
The description omits the specific colors of the bars (e.g., dark purple, dark blue, teal, light green) as detailed in the atom.
The description does not mention the numeric annotations on the bars, which are explicitly highlighted in the atom.
The description does not explicitly state that the tallest bar ('Relevant FCs') is highlighted, as mentioned in the atom.
